API token gate — every /api/* request now requires a per-session cryptographic token (X-EGM-Token header). Token generated fresh by Electron at startup, passed to Flask via environment variable, injected into pages via Jinja. Prevents drive-by localhost requests from malicious websites or local processes
Fail-closed update verification — checksum parameter is now required on /api/download-update. Returns 400 if missing, ensuring no update can proceed without SHA256 verification
Request body size limits — global 2 MB cap (MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH) on all requests. Cookies endpoint capped at 1 MB specifically. Oversized requests return 413

Thread safety — jobs dictionary mutations (creation, deletion) now wrapped with _jobs_lock. Job read in download worker uses .get() with early return guard. Prevents race conditions between concurrent downloads and cleanup worker

Scripts security audit — all 4 build/validation scripts reviewed: no eval/exec, subprocess limited to read-only git ls-files, all paths relative to repo root, no user-controlled path construction. Clean bill of health
Cookies browse now uses native file dialog instead of browser file picker — fixes cookies browse on Linux and improves reliability on all platforms
Cookies section condensed to single always-visible row with extension tooltips — no more expand/collapse needed
Download folder section condensed — removed redundant "Files saved to" line
Check for Updates button moved to Update Plugins header — auto-expands panel when clicked
Advanced panel: added descriptive tooltips to all action buttons (Desktop shortcut, Clear cache, Export/Import settings, Reinstall ffmpeg/Deno, Reset settings)
Version tooltip removed from header badge — cleaner look

Dead code cleanup: removed legacy password-protected zip support (APP_UPDATE_PASSWORD, pyzipper dependency) from all platforms — codebase now reflects v0.98 unencrypted distribution model with SHA256 verification

[MAC] Fixed yt-dlp update mechanism — Python bundle's pip module (required for runtime plugin updates) was inadvertently stripped during the v0.98 size optimization. Restored selectively to enable plugin updates without losing size benefits

[MAC] YouTube downloads using latest yt-dlp version (2026.03.17) — extractor fixes for recent YouTube changes now apply automatically through the restored update path. Other sites were unaffected by the previous issue
Window position is not remembered between sessions on Wayland compositors. Cosmetic only — app launches centered on each start.
Virtual machine environments (VMware, VirtualBox, etc.) may experience display rendering issues. The app is primarily designed and tested for bare-metal Linux installations.
Open folder from expanded download history panel now works correctly (history window was missing API bridge that prevented folder actions)
Video thumbnail aspect ratio corrected — widescreen (16:9) videos now display at proper proportions instead of appearing stretched vertically
Version references corrected — footer version pill and What's New header now update correctly during version bumps (scripts coverage gap fixed)
Window position is not remembered between sessions on Wayland compositors. Cosmetic only — app launches centered on each start.

Electron runtime upgraded to v41.5.0 (security and compatibility improvements; v29 line is end-of-life with no security backports — this upgrade incorporates accumulated Chromium security fixes and backported CVEs from the Electron security advisory line)
electron-builder updated to v26.8.1 (build toolchain compatibility with Electron 41)
Improved window initialization reliability — main window now appears consistently when launched from file manager or application launcher on GNOME/Mutter compositors (Ubuntu 24 and similar distros)
Open folder from the expanded download history panel does not work — use the hamburger menu's open folder action instead. Fix planned for next release.

Splash window and certain secondary panels (themes, expanded history, footer link popups) may appear off-center (typically top-left) on first display. Functional behavior unaffected. Targeted fix planned for next release.
Cookies browse dialog does not open on Linux. Linux-specific issue, fix planned for upcoming release.
